actual_request.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Produce a production character turnaround sheet for the fantasy animated short 穿云. The user has explicitly selected FOUR FULL-BODY VIEWS, overriding any portrait-plus-three-view template. EXACTLY four figures of the SAME character, side by side in one row, in this order: (1) straight front facing camera, (2) true 90-degree profile with nose pointing to image LEFT, (3) true straight back with face invisible, (4) true 90-degree profile with nose pointing to image RIGHT. All four full bodies at exactly the same scale with aligned head and foot levels, complete headdress, hair, hands, clothing hems and feet inside the canvas. Neutral relaxed standing pose, arms down and slightly clear of torso, same pose rotated, NOT a T-pose; no walking, pointing or posing. Near orthographic eye-level view with no perspective distortion. Generous unbroken vertical blank gutters separate figures. Plain pale warm-grey opaque background, even neutral soft light, minimal ground shadow. Wide landscape about 3:1 ratio, render as large and detailed as possible. No title, no captions, no letters, no numbers, no arrows, no rulers, no prompt text, no palette blocks, no accessory mini-panels, no portrait inset, no watermarks. Exactly 4 full-body figures; never a large bust. Preserve identity, specific clothing construction and placement of asymmetric ornaments across rotation. Side views must be actual sides, not mirrored duplicates or three-quarter poses. Hidden structures may be coherently completed but no redesign or added accessories. Preserve the original illustration medium and original costume colors.
Character CLAUDE. Reference 1 is the primary original authority for face, copper-orange hair with fringe, amber eyes, orange chrysanthemum-like flower on the character's LEFT temple (viewer's right in front view), black hanging ribbons, ivory delicate lace veil, modest high ruffled collar, ivory dress with rust-orange botanical/sunburst embroidery and black ribbon at neckline. Reference 2 is the current full-length costume development for lower skirt, long veil and hair, and ivory low-heeled embroidered shoes; preserve its consistent construction rather than inventing a new dress. Maintain youthful anime face and the delicate richly detailed illustrative rendering, fine embroidered texture and translucent lace, neither chibi nor photorealistic. Long copper hair reaches low back/upper thighs, veil extends down back, layered long ivory full skirt almost touching ground, both shoe fronts visible where naturally possible. Keep the flower on the same actual temple; in the opposite profile the far-side flower may be partly hidden, never moved. Both back and side views have the same lace sleeves, neckline, waist and orange embroidery placement as the front. Solely this same orange-haired character, no dragon anatomy. Do not copy the black-robed crowd or dark background from reference 1.
